title: the past can be changed
subtitle: remission is retroactive alteration
continuity_object: timeline being rewritten from the present moment

scenes.title: The claim
scenes.narration: Remission of sins means 'to send back' — the past can be altered.

scenes.title: Early Christian knowledge
scenes.narration: The early Christians understood that forgiveness is retroactive healing.

scenes.title: The fixed past
scenes.narration: We assume the past is settled — immutable, unchangeable.

scenes.title: The assumption
scenes.narration: But is this an assumption about reality or a limitation of perception?

scenes.title: The quantum eraser
scenes.narration: In the lab, a future measurement determines a past event's trajectory.

scenes.title: Delayed choice
scenes.narration: Wheeler's delayed choice experiment: choice now decides what happened.

scenes.title: The present as power
scenes.narration: If the past is not fixed, the present is the only point of power.

scenes.title: Now changes everything
scenes.narration: What you do now reaches backward and forward.

scenes.title: Seth on the past
scenes.narration: 'Each present moment brings its own built-in past along with it.'

scenes.title: Not given — chosen
scenes.narration: The past is not a given — it is a selection from probability.

scenes.title: Caution
scenes.narration: Quantum eraser is real. Retroactive causality is theoretical.

scenes.title: The therapeutic truth
scenes.narration: Whether or not the past physically changes, your relationship to it can.

scenes.title: Closing
scenes.narration: The past is not a prison. It is a story you can rewrite.

scenes.title: Final frame
scenes.narration: Send healing backward. The past is listening.
